section6_evaluationProposal.title: [Diagnostic] JPMorgan Chase — AUDIT_LIFECYCLE assessment using synthetic data
section6_evaluationProposal.scope: Synthetic-data assessment of the institution's audit-logging pipeline against Vardhan's Audit Ledger with BLAKE3 hash chaining and ML-DSA-87 signing.
section6_evaluationProposal.methodology: Provide a synthetic event log dataset (5,000-20,000 entries) mirroring security-patch deployment events. Run Vardhan's AuditLedgerValidator against the dataset. Demonstrate end-to-end verifiability and tamper-evidence.
section6_evaluationProposal.dataHandling: All evaluation data is synthetic — no production bank data, credentials, or customer information are used. All evidence is derived from public sources only.
